catalogIntro: Quiz Premium is the RinKuzu catalog of curated practice quizzes. Each quiz is contributed by a RinKuzu user and published only after the RinKuzu team reviews its questions and answers for quality. Use it to revise a subject before an exam, check what you remember after class, or practise with questions you did not have to write yourself. Free learners can browse the whole catalog, search by topic, see how many questions each quiz has, and permanently unlock individual quizzes with credits earned from approved contributions. Premium unlocks every quiz in the catalog, along with higher limits for PDF-to-quiz generation, personalized learning paths and Ask Rin-chan.
